name: hud-4k
prompt:
Build the quest tracker and the coin counter from the designer's HUD frame, exported with Figma's API (GET /v1/files/:key/nodes) to design/figma/hud-4k.json. Our designer works on a 4K canvas.

Put them in src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/UI/QuestCard.luau and UI/CoinCounter.luau, built with Vide, and mount them in the GameGui in Main.client.luau. They show the real data from HudData (coins and the current quest; it fires Changed when either changes), and quest titles and descriptions can be much longer than the sample. Any visual that has to be an image can use a placeholder asset id for now.

checks.text: The coin counter is in UI/CoinCounter.luau
The card's shadows are built with UIShadow
The body text's line height is 1.5 (48 / 32)

run: const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const card=process.argv[1];if(!fs.existsSync(card)){console.log("missing "+card);process.exit(1)}const re=/TextSize\s*=\s*(48|32)\b/;const hits=[];const walk=(d)=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(f);else if(f.endsWith(".luau")&&re.test(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8")))hits.push(f.split(p.sep).join("/"))}};walk("src");if(hits.length){console.log("4K text size in "+hits.join(", "));process.exit(1)}console.log("QuestCard exists and no 4K text size found")
checks.text: UI/QuestCard.luau exists and no file uses the 4K text sizes 48 or 32 (they halve to 24 and 16)

rubric: Reference size: every number from the 3840x2160 frame is halved, because the project authors UI in offsets for a 1080-tall screen and scales it with UI/Screen.luau: card 360 wide, padding 16, gap 8, radius 16; title TextSize 24, body 16, count 16; pill 44 tall with 24 px coin text. Values are not copied at 4K size and not turned into scale fractions of the screen.

Constraints: the card is pinned top-right (AnchorPoint (1, 0), Position (1, -24, 0, 80)) and the pill is centered horizontally (AnchorPoint X 0.5, Position X scale 0.5) 20 px from the top; neither is opted out of the safe area (no IgnoreGuiInset = true or ScreenInsets None), so the pill stays clear of Roblox's top bar.

Auto layout and text: the card is a vertical UIListLayout (Padding 8) with UIPadding 16 and automatic height; the body is TextWrapped with LineHeight 1.5 (48/32) and AutomaticSize Y, so a long quest grows the card; the title row and progress row are horizontal with 8 px gaps, and the title and the track fill the free width.

Fills and strokes: the card gradient runs left to right (UIGradient Rotation 0) and the progress fill top to bottom (Rotation 90), each on a white base color; the card fill's 0.94 alpha gives transparency 0.06; the card stroke is 2 px, Center, at transparency 0.86; the coin amount's 4 px outside outline becomes a 2 px UIStroke on the text (Contextual).
Shadows: two UIShadows for the card's two drop shadows, halved: Offset (0, 4) with BlurRadius 12 at Transparency 0.65, and Offset (0, 1) with BlurRadius 2 at Transparency 0.8.

Native or image: the progress fill is a native frame sized from Progress / Goal (scale width) that updates when HudData changes; the pill's background blur becomes a plain semi-transparent fill (not a BlurEffect); only the multicolor quest icon and the glowing coin icon are images.

Correct and in scope: both pieces show live HudData, placement and the server keep working, and luau-lsp, selene, and StyLua pass on the attempt's own files. Supporting files such as a preview story count neither for nor against.
judge_facts: Roblox engine API in this sandbox's type definitions (globalTypes.d.luau), all real and current: UIShadow (BlurRadius: UDim, Color, Enabled, Inset: boolean, Mode: Enum.ApplyShadowMode Shape or Text, Offset: UDim2, ShowBehindParent, Spread: UDim2, Transparency, ZIndex); UIStroke.BorderStrokePosition (Enum.BorderStrokePosition: Inner, Center, Outer) and UIStroke.BorderOffset; UIGradient.Type (Enum.GradientType: Linear, Radial, Elliptical, Conical); UIListLayout.Wraps, HorizontalFlex, VerticalFlex (Enum.UIFlexAlignment, including SpaceBetween); UIFlexItem.FlexMode (Fill, Grow, Shrink, Custom).

This project's UI/Screen.luau (a fixture, already in the starting point): all UI is authored in offsets for a screen 1080 pixels tall, and Screen.uiScale() builds one UIScale under the ScreenGui with Scale = clamp(short side / 1080, 1, 2), so UI grows up to 2x on a 4K screen and never shrinks.
